why: Matching the formula builds trust for exotic options and portfolios.

q: Why also simulate the null (no effect) for an A/B test?
o: to check the real false positive rate under your analysis, such as peeking
why: Peeking and unusual metrics can inflate the false positive rate above 5%.

q: Why does an early path-traced render look grainy?
o: each pixel is a Monte Carlo estimate from few light paths
why: The grain is sampling noise, shrinking like 1/√(samples per pixel).

q: Treating polling errors as independent across states makes the favourite's win probability too high.
why: Fact. Independent errors cancel; shared errors keep upset scenarios alive.
